programme.title: Rico to the Rescue S2 Ep09 ((Rico to 龙族救援骑士：天空英雄 S2 Ep09))
programme.desc: A couples home addition has been continually delayed for almost a year. When Rico takes over the task, he uncovers more issues than expected. (当Rico接手这项任务时,他发现了比预期更多的问题。)

programme.title: Rico to the Rescue S2 Ep06 ((Rico to 龙族救援骑士：天空英雄 S2 Ep06))
programme.desc: A family hired a builder to renovate their kitchen, but he went missing after demolition. Rico uncovers disturbing information while tracking him. (一个家庭雇用了一名建筑工来整修厨房,但他在拆除后失踪。)

programme.title: Fixer to Fabulous S4 Ep08 ((固色 to Fabulous S4 Ep08))
programme.desc: Dave and Jenny renovate a second-floor apartment in their historic Centerton building to create a space for friends and family to stay. (Dave和Jenny更新了他们具有历史意义的Centleton大楼的二楼公寓,为朋友和家人留下创造空间。)

programme.title: Flip or Flop S9 Ep09 ((改建重建大作战 S9 Ep09))
programme.desc: Tarek and Christina find a small house in Lakewood, CA, to flip quickly. (Tarek和Christina在加州Lakewood找到一间小房子 快速翻转)

programme.title: Flipping 101 With Tarek El Moussa S2 Ep03 (与Tarek El Moussa S2 Ep03合作,)
programme.desc: Having ended their romantic relationship but remaining business partners,two Flipping 101 graduates are chasing their biggest profit yet. (两位101名毕业生在追逐最大的利润。)

programme.title: Renovation Aloha S2 Ep02 (改造 Aloha S2 Ep02)
programme.desc: Kamohai and Tristyn purchase a house in Manoa with a mould-infested room and major roof damage, and they must take on a second flip to cover the cost. (卡莫哈伊和特里斯廷在玛诺亚买了一房子,房间充满了模具,屋顶严重损坏,)

programme.title: Backed by the Bros S1 Ep05 (由兄弟S1Ep05支持)
programme.desc: The Brothers must choose between a rookie investor struggling with a multi-million dollar flip, and a widow whos sitting on valuable real estate. (弟兄们必须选择 要么是新手投资者 与数百万美元的翻转斗争 要么是坐在贵重房地产上的寡妇)

programme.title: Wild Vacation Rentals S1 Ep08 ((Wild 假期历险记 Rentals S1 Ep08))
programme.desc: Comedians DArcy Carden and Sherry Cola explore Californias High Desert rentals, including a lazy river resort and an artsy animal sanctuary. (喜剧演员DArcy Carden 和Sherry Cola 探索加州高沙漠租借地,)

programme.title: Worlds Bargain Dream Homes S1 Ep04 (S1 Ep04号)
programme.desc: A creative pair seek an artistic life and tour breathtaking bargain homes in Puglia, Italy. With an expert guide, they experience Italian countryside. (创意夫妇在意大利普格利亚寻找艺术生活和令人惊叹的竞技之家,他们有专家指导,在意大利农村体验。)

programme.title: Home Town S9 Ep11 (家乡S9 Ep11)
programme.desc: Erins friend asks Ben and Erin to turn a dated, well-kept house into a Southern-inspired forever home, but surprises lurk beneath the surface. (埃林斯的朋友请本和艾琳 把一栋有历史背景的好房子 变成一个南方启发的永久家园 但惊喜潜伏在地表之下)

programme.title: Fixer to Fabulous S6 Ep12 ((固色 to Fabulous S6 Ep12))
programme.desc: After devastating tornadoes damaged a young familys home, Dave and Jenny repair what was lost while also giving them the renovation of their dreams. (在毁灭性的龙卷风摧毁了一家年轻家庭之后,Dave和Jenny修复了失去的房屋,同时为他们更新了梦想。)

programme.title: Renovation Aloha S3 Ep08 (Aloha S3 Ep08翻新)
programme.desc: Kamohai and Tristyn travel to Maui to help rebuild a home lost in the Lahaina fires, rallying a community to restore hope for a grieving family. (Kamohai和Tristyn前往毛伊帮助重建在拉希纳大火中失去的家园,)

programme.title: Rock the Block S7 Ep06 ((街区大作战 S7 Ep06))
programme.desc: After winning swimming pools, teams head outside to the backyard to create a Vegas-worthy entertaining oasis before Danny Amendola arrives to judge. (赢得游泳池后, 球队前往后院, 在Danny Amendola来评判之前,)

programme.title: Worlds Bargain Dream Homes S1 Ep04 (S1 Ep04号)

programme.title: Flip or Flop S9 Ep07 ((改建重建大作战 S9 Ep07))
programme.desc: Tarek and Christina are lured to North Hollywood, CA, by a 1930s Spanish home. (Tarek和Christina被1930年代西班牙人 引诱到加州北好莱坞)

programme.title: House Hunters International S203 Ep02 ((房屋猎人 S203 Ep02))
programme.desc: Despite working long hours, a young couple couldnt afford to buy a home in pricey San Francisco. Theyre hoping for a bargain in Edinburgh, Scotland. (尽管工作时间很长,但一对年轻夫妇在价格昂贵的旧金山买不起房子。 他们希望在苏格兰爱丁堡达成交易。)

programme.title: Flip or Flop S8 Ep13 ((改建重建大作战 S8 Ep13))

programme.desc: Rebecca and Kristy get a lead on a house in the Oak Hill neighbourhood of Austin. The kitchen and main bath are a hodgepodge of basic builder-grade finishes and the layout of the house is confusing. (Rebecca和Kristy在奥斯丁奥克山居民区的一所房屋上找到线索。 厨房和主浴室是基本建筑工品级的修饰品,房屋布局混乱。)

programme.title: Rachael Ray in Tuscany Ep09 (雷切尔·雷在托斯卡纳 Ep09)
programme.desc: Rachael prepares a popular Tuscan dish of red wine-infused beef stew served with creamy polenta. (拉切尔准备一个受欢迎的托斯卡菜,)

programme.title: Rachael Ray in Tuscany Ep10 (雷切尔·雷在托斯卡纳 Ep10)
programme.desc: Racheal teams up with her friend, chef and author, Anna Gass, to make an Italian version of fried grilled cheese, also known as a carrozza, along with a hearty roasted tomato soup. (拉切尔和她的朋友,厨师和作家安娜·加斯合作,)

programme.title: Global Soul Kitchen S2 Ep21 ((心灵厨房 S2 Ep21))
programme.desc: Chef Deborah takes the chicken and waffles to the next level with her duck schnitzel and sweet potato waffles. She marinates and fries the duck, then mixes baked sweet potatoes with egg, milk and spices. (厨师德波拉将和饼带到下一个层次,用子和甜饼.她和子,然后混合烤的甜蛋,牛奶和香料.)

programme.title: Enlighten Your Life S3 Ep05 ((许你万家灯火 S3 Ep05))
programme.desc: As people spend more time at home due to the pandemic, interest in home decor has surged. Well be showcasing two distinct styles: a Hanok that embodies Eastern beauty, and a Western-style house. (由于人们由于疫情而在家里花更多时间,家居装饰的兴趣也激增了.)

programme.title: A Nurse to Die for ((看护阴谋))
programme.desc: A father hires a live-in nurse to help care for his sick daughter, however, as she suffers a series of setbacks, he starts to wonder if the nurse might actually be the one keeping her sick. (一个父亲雇佣一个住宿护士来照顾他的生病的女儿,)

programme.title: The Face I Cant Forget ((无法忘怀的脸))
programme.desc: After waking from a car accident with total amnesia, Mia is taken home to be cared for by her loving husband and daughter. But as she recuperates, Mia has flashbacks of a second daughter. (经过一场车祸,完全失忆,米亚醒来后,被带回家,被她爱的丈夫和女儿照顾.)

programme.title: Got to Leave Something Ep02 ((Love Me Harder（2014年爱莉安娜·格兰德与威肯合作歌曲） Ep02))
programme.desc: The journey heads towards the picturesque water city of Chuncheon. Nam-gil and Sang-yoon meet a travelling doctor who works in remote villages without medical facilities and join him on his rounds. (吉尔和桑约恩遇到了一个在偏远村庄工作的医生,他没有医疗设施,并加入了他的巡回活动.)

programme.title: Airline Wars Ep03 (航空战 Ep03)
programme.desc: A cancelled flight to a dream vacation sends a mother over the edge. A pilot has no choice but to restrain an allegedly intoxicated man. Reports of gunshots at JFK causes complete pandemonium. (飞行员不得不阻止一名据称醉酒的人. 报道说,在JFK发生枪击事件导致了完全的流行.)

programme.title: 1,000 Ways to Dine Ep01 ((中文名 Ep01))
programme.desc: Host Michael Yo introduces viewers to dining destinations deemed impossible - but also delicious! First up, a trip to Thailand to sip tea in a tree before jetting off to a restaurant balanced on a rock. (导演迈克尔·约介绍给观众看不到可能但也很好吃的餐点!)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep41 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep41))
programme.desc: As Knockout Week continues, the MasterChef judges have each filled a fridge with ingredients. Eight contestants must choose a fridge, without looking inside, and use its contents to make a dish. (随着击倒周的继续,马斯特涅夫(Masteref)法官每人都把冰箱装满了原料。 八位参赛者必须选择冰箱,而不看里面,并用冰箱的内容做盘子。)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep42 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep42))
programme.desc: Its Knockout Week, and two teams of three, led by Andy and Jean-Christophe, must deliver a two-course fine-dining menu for sixteen Coles Farmers. The losing team will head into tomorrows elimination. (由安迪和让-赫托斐领导的两组三人小组必须为16个科尔斯农民提供双道精细餐单。 输家小组将走向明天的淘汰。)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep43 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep43))
programme.desc: Its Knockout Week and the first elimination for the top ten. To keep their place in the competition, the seven contestants cooking must feature an ingredient chosen by one of their fellow cooks. (为了保持其在比赛中的地位,七位参赛者在烹饪时必须配上他们一位厨师所选的成分。)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep44 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep44))
programme.desc: Our top nine contestants welcome one of the most famous chefs in India. With over 150 cookbooks and 20 million social media followers, its Chef Sanjeev Kapoor, here to set a mystery box. (我们的九大参赛者欢迎印度最著名的厨师之一。 印度有150多本烹饪书籍和2 000万社交媒体追随者,其厨师Sanjeev Kapoor在这里设置了一个神秘盒子。)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep45 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep45))
programme.desc: In an elimination cook-off, contestants must produce a dish featuring one of five internationally sourced ingredients that they have never used before. For one cook, it will be their final dish. (在消除烹饪中,参赛者必须生产出一种配有他们以前从未使用过的五种国际原料之一的菜。 对于一个厨师来说,这是他们最后的菜。)

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out S2 Ep13 ((挤痘大师: Breaking Out S2 Ep13))
programme.desc: Dr. Lee is cleared to perform surgery after her stroke. As she continues with rehab, she and Montana surgeon Dr. Kristen Townley work together to help Brandi, whose huge back bump is hurting her mobility. (Lee医生在中风后可以进行手术,她和Montana外科医生Kristen Townley博士在继续戒毒期间合作帮助Brandi,Brandi的后遗症正在损害她的流动性。)

programme.desc: When Lauren gives up the corporate life and a cheating boyfriend, she joins her best friend working aboard a yacht in the South Pacific. As her first voyage sets sail, she falls for entrepreneur Mark. (劳伦放弃了公司生活和一个骗子男朋友,她加入了她最好的朋友在南太平洋的游艇上工作.)

programme.title: A Nurse to Die for ((看护阴谋))
programme.desc: A father hires a live-in nurse to help care for his sick daughter, however, as she suffers a series of setbacks, he starts to wonder if the nurse might actually be the one keeping her sick. (一个父亲雇佣一个住宿护士来照顾他的生病的女儿,)

programme.title: The Face I Cant Forget ((无法忘怀的脸))
programme.desc: After waking from a car accident with total amnesia, Mia is taken home to be cared for by her loving husband and daughter. But as she recuperates, Mia has flashbacks of a second daughter. (经过一场车祸,完全失忆,米亚醒来后,被带回家,被她爱的丈夫和女儿照顾.)

programme.title: Got to Leave Something Ep05 ((Love Me Harder（2014年爱莉安娜·格兰德与威肯合作歌曲） Ep05))
programme.desc: Nam-gil and Sang-yoon arrive at the end of Korea, at the beautiful Mihwangsa Temple in Haenam, with a stunning view of the South Sea. They spend a day at the temple, with the head monk. (吉尔和桑在韩国末端抵达海南美满寺院,俯南海.)

programme.title: The Mother Flip S1 Ep10 (母翻转 S1 Ep10)
programme.desc: Rebecca and Kristy drive to San Antonio to check out a foreclosure that a friend scored at auction. The house is a time capsule from the 1970s, complete with dirty shag carpet and a faulty HVAC system. (Rebecca和Kristy开车去圣安东尼奥 检查一个朋友在拍卖会上得分的分)

programme.title: Rachael Ray in Tuscany Ep11 (雷切尔·雷在托斯卡纳 Ep11)
programme.desc: Rachael prepares a hearty and healthy meal for her Italian friends, combining store-bought and homemade ingredients to make flavourful, protein-rich ramen bowls. (拉切尔为她的意大利朋友做好了一顿健康的餐,)

programme.title: Rachael Ray in Tuscany Ep12 (雷切尔·雷在托斯卡纳 Ep12)
programme.desc: Rachael prepares a traditional pollo al mattone, an Italian roast chicken, by seasoning spatchcock chickens, cooking them in a pan with a brick wrapped in tin foil, and serving them with sauteed greens. (拉切尔通过调味子,用子包裹在片中煮,并用菜供应传统的意大利烤.)

programme.title: Global Soul Kitchen S2 Ep22 ((心灵厨房 S2 Ep22))
programme.desc: Chef Deborah puts a Southern spin on the classic French-inspired chicken fricassee. She starts by seasoning and browning the chicken, then simmers it in a sauce made with vegetables, cream and white wine. (厨师德波拉开始调味,然后将煮在用蔬菜,奶油和白葡萄酒制成的汁中.)

programme.title: Enlighten Your Life S3 Ep06 ((许你万家灯火 S3 Ep06))
programme.desc: Todays first up is the Self-Renewal House, a 40-year-old apartment beautifully transformed! Next, well introduce the Co-Living House, a new concept in housing thats becoming increasingly popular! (今天,第一家是自修房子,一个40年历史的房子,)

programme.title: A Roommate to Die for ((为之而死的室友))
programme.desc: After a nasty breakup, Faith needs a new roommate to pay for the home. The new renter seems great until Faith finds that something very strange is going on. (在一个糟糕的分手之后,菲思需要一个新的室友来支付房子.)

programme.title: The Girl Who Wasnt Dead (没有死的女孩)
programme.desc: This is the story of 15-year-old Erica who vanished without a trace. Authorities believed Erica may have been the victim of a local serial killer, but her mother, Carrie refused to believe the worst. (这是一个15岁的埃里卡的故事,她没有留下任何痕迹,当局认为埃里卡可能是当地的一名连环杀手的受害者,)

programme.title: Got to Leave Something Ep03 ((Love Me Harder（2014年爱莉安娜·格兰德与威肯合作歌曲） Ep03))
programme.desc: The two adventurers follow the mountaineer deep into the remote areas of Jiri Mountain. They experience a feast with makgeolli Korean rice wine and local mountain folk. (两位冒险家跟随了登山者深入到吉里山的偏远地区.)

programme.title: Airline Wars Ep04 (航空战 Ep04)
programme.desc: A combative passenger responds with punches when asked to follow FAA regulations. When air marshals attempt to remove a man from the wing of a stationary aircraft, he plummets to the ground. (当空军警方试图将一名男子从停飞机的翼中移除时,他倒下地面.)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep46 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep46))
programme.desc: The top eight of MasterChef Australia get to select a Connoisseur ice cream to start the day. Cooking for immunity, they must cook a dessert inspired by their ice cream flavour. (澳洲马斯特谢夫(Masteref Australia)的头八位可以选择一个冰淇淋来开始一天。 他们为免疫做饭,必须做一个甜点,这是他们冰淇淋的味道所启发的。)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep47 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep47))
programme.desc: In a high-stakes pressure test featuring Michelin-starred Chef Sam Aisbetts Crab Salad, four contestants must navigate complex technical components and personal errors to avoid elimination. (在由米其林明星厨师Sam Aisbetts Crab Salad主持的高压测试中,四名参赛者必须驾驶复杂的技术部件和个人错误,以避免消除。)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep48 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep48))
programme.desc: To mark the start of Heat Week, food and media mogul Marion Grasby returns to the MasterChef for the first time in sixteen years, with a spicy mystery box challenge. (为了纪念热周的开始, 食物和媒体的mogul Marion Grasby 十六年来首次返回Masteref, 面临一个辣味神秘盒的挑战。)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep49 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep49))
programme.desc: Heat Week continues with a looming elimination as six of the seven remaining cooks are challenged to create a hot new chilli dish in just 60 minutes. (剩下的七位厨师中, 六位在60分钟内就准备制作热辣辣椒盘,)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep50 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep50))
programme.desc: In todays episode of MasterChef Australia, five cooks must prove their skill and creativity using only a hibachi to cook, with the winner earning immunity and their spot in the Top 6. (在今日的《澳洲万事达》系列中, 五名厨师必须证明他们的技能和创造力,)

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out S2 Ep14 ((挤痘大师: Breaking Out S2 Ep14))
programme.desc: Brittanys life and career are a shambles since her nose and cheeks erupted with bright-red, oozing bumps. Dr. Sheila Farhang joins Dr. Lee for a lesson on how to remove Johns painful, inflamed cysts. (自从她的鼻子和脸颊 爆发出明亮的红肿块后, 生活和事业就变得一团糟。)

programme.title: Little Girl in the Window ((橱窗里的小女孩))
programme.desc: When amateur photographer Iris notices HELP scrawled on a dusty window in a picture she took of a house, she becomes increasingly convinced that the man living there isnt as mild-mannered as he seems. (当爱好者摄影师爱丽丝在她拍摄的房子照片中看到HELP在一扇尘埃的窗口上划痕时,她越来越确信那个住在那里的人不是他看起来那么温和的.)

programme.title: Jaguar Journals S1 Ep05 (捷日报S1 Ep05)
programme.desc: Watch the Oncafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. (观看奥卡法里团队了解Aroeira,他们的新领女,)

programme.title: Superbeast S1 Ep01 ((超级野兽 S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs. (在动物王国最强大的动物国的强大力量中,巴斯克(Bask)最强大。 以银背大猩猩的岩石硬石白蚁猎犬,用银背大猩猩击打,看到能够粉碎caiman头骨的美洲虎,然后前往海洋见证猎豹群。)

programme.title: Superbeast S1 Ep02 ((超级野兽 S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey. (随着地球最快的动物运动员的击球, 观看死亡鱼在瞬间袭击, 用鱼进行空中暗杀, 与马龙一起快速吃饭,)

programme.title: Baby Animals S1 Ep02 ((动物宝宝 S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: Not all infants in the animal kingdom get to have a good mother. But these are the stories of the lucky ones. (动物王国里并非所有的婴儿都能有一个好母亲,但这些都是幸运者的故事。)

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends S1 Ep01 ((Amazing Animal 老友记 S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer. (这部"惊人的动物朋友"的集中,有一个子,没有她的朋友带她去水里,)

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil S1 Ep01 ((Secret 终生惩戒 of the Tasmanian Devil S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes. (对于塔斯马尼亚魔鬼来说,统治是交配季节游戏的名称。 与为传承基因的权利而奋斗的男性见面。)

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil S1 Ep02 ((Secret 终生惩戒 of the Tasmanian Devil S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the countrys marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. (塔斯马尼亚恶魔可能拥有任何国家最臭名昭著的名声,)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk S1 Ep05 ((神奇动物的一天 S1 Ep05))
programme.desc: Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. (活在一个阳光明的热带9月天,)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk S1 Ep06 ((神奇动物的一天 S1 Ep06))
programme.desc: Celebrate the first day of spring with Aussie creatures looking for either a dinner or a date. (庆祝春天的第一天,与澳洲生物寻找晚餐或约会.)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk S1 Ep07 ((神奇动物的一天 S1 Ep07))
programme.desc: Meet the unique primates and reptiles searching for water and dodging predators, in this land of extreme climate variations and habitats. (在这个极端气候变化和息地的国家, 遇见寻找水和逃避掠食者的独特的灵长和爬行动物.)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk S1 Ep08 ((神奇动物的一天 S1 Ep08))
programme.desc: Visit one of the most arid and hottest parts of the world to discover how dhub lizards and dromedary camels adapted to withstand the intense conditions. (参观世界上最干燥和最热的地方,)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia S2 Ep06 ((赞比亚传奇 S2 Ep06))
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. (非洲是一个充满独特而非凡的生物的大陆,这些生物的生命是由数百万年的进化塑造的.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia S2 Ep07 ((赞比亚传奇 S2 Ep07))
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. (千勒马是一个半个子的象,被偷猎者陷所掉了头条.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia S2 Ep08 ((赞比亚传奇 S2 Ep08))
programme.desc: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter. (树木是非洲最古老的居民,每个树都有自己的生存策略.)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1 Ep01 ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影） S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. (开始在南澳大利亚进行危险的标签任务,)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1 Ep02 ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影） S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast. (追踪一个怀孕的鱼沿着大礁礁,看看她是否带领一组科学家到她的隐藏的鱼种植地,然后在南海岸寻找交配迹象.)

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1 Ep04 ((地球演化實錄 S1 Ep04))
programme.desc: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. (走向快速融化的极地,动物给科学家提供有关我们未来存在的线索.)

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1 Ep05 ((地球演化實錄 S1 Ep05))
programme.desc: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. (探索地球最重要但被忽视的息地之一,)

programme.title: Wild Science S1 Ep01 (野生科学S1Ep01)
programme.desc: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts. (追寻狮子从史前掠食者上升到现代统治者,因为科学揭示了塑造了这个具有象征意义的非洲猎人的战斗、纽带和残酷的生存策略。 被狮子社会和高风险狩猎的剧情扫荡一空。)

programme.title: Wild Science S1 Ep02 (野生科学S1Ep02)
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks. (了解这些生物的优势 帮助这些史前物种生存下来 经历了多次大规模灭绝 并被公牛鲨鱼无情的捕猎技巧所迷惑)

programme.title: Planet Shark S1 Ep01 ((鲨鱼星球 S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat. (鱼用强大的感官和杀手本能去猎海. 看一条白尖的珊瑚把电传感器运行到猎物心跳.)

programme.title: Planet Shark S1 Ep02 ((鲨鱼星球 S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. (乘坐在蓝色空空中繁荣的游牧鱼,)

programme.title: Planet Shark S1 Ep03 ((鲨鱼星球 S1 Ep03))

programme.title: Cold Eyes (寒冷的眼睛)

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: On The Way
programme.desc: This large-scale tourism programme is designed to present the rich tourism resources in China and around the world.

programme.title: Treasures Found
programme.desc: This programme focuses on national treasures and archaeology.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy fathers dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting Alfred Chang who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bos magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Openthe Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qins celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. Live debates linking movers and shakers take place in the signature s

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Dialogue
programme.desc: Dialogue is a prime time daily English talk show on CGTN. The 30-minute talk show covers a wide range of domestic and international topics, providing a balanced and critical perspective on current affairs and analysis within the framework of cross-cultural and multi-disciplinary comparisons. Inviting decision makers in government, business and academia onto the show, the host encourages guests to

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTNs English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents.

programme.title: The Point with Liu Xin
programme.desc: The Point with LIU Xin is a current affairs program on CGTN. The program comments on global news through LIU Xins very own unique perspective. With two decades of experience as a news anchor and overseas correspondent, LIU Xin has an engaging and personal style. The Point with LIU Xin connects world audience through social media, enhancing their participation as well as offering a comprehensive p

programme.title: Americas Now
programme.desc: Americas Now profiles the development, diversity and challenges facing the Americas, particularly Latin America. The strength of the program is its storytelling. Correspondents across the region present insightful, well-researched and engaging narratives. Americas Now is a compelling, authoritative and balanced voice from the region, giving CGTN a competitive edge in the North American media marke

programme.title: The Heat
programme.desc: The Heat is a daily talk show anchored from Washington, D.C. It focuses on top stories making news globally. The Heat presents tough issues from a comprehensive, balanced and international and Chinese perspective. Guests from on the spot and around the world ensure lively debate and a range of voices. programme.title: What On Earth S2 - EP 23 ((卫星看地球 S2 - EP 23))

programme.title: What On Earth S2 - EP 24 ((卫星看地球 S2 - EP 24))

But Maxie isnt finished - theyre not returning to Zetabia... Zetabia is coming here. What?!!!! (Maxi 叔叔抵达此地是为了宣布大消息。 但是他们都为了甩掉他而费尽心思,想让他离开。 最后他把他们压下来,宣布他们不会返回Zetabia。现在,他们决定了,他们实际上已经松了一口气—— 地球已经到家了。但是Maxie还没有完成,他们不能回到Zetabia。Zetabia要来这里。什么?!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!)

programme.desc: The series traces the rich heritage of the Kenyah people from their origins in the Usun Apau highlands. programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - The Ditch Sitch
programme.desc: The crew gets their first ping on their new creature-helping app! A dried up jellyfish-type creature has been discovered at a construction site, and the anti-creature contractor wants it GONE. The crew try taking Jelleen to the sewers to live with Sewer Koi, but the unhappy creature creates a blackout in the sewers with its magical electric charge. Realizing that Jelleen should be able to stay in

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Bad Company
programme.desc: Circumstantial evidence has Birch certain Raffis fallen in with a bad crowd. His frequent absences, new friends and secretive behaviour point to one thing for Birch who has a hard time convincing her friends. A note, its content misconstrued, finally convinces everyone of Raffis dire predicament.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Manga Slam
programme.desc: An attempt to quell Liams manic energy throws Birch into conflict. Does she continue helping her hyperactive cousin learn to relax or does she pull him into the schools Manga Slam? Will Liam become too relaxed or bring a never-before-seen energy to Cosmos Highs stage?

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Theyre Watching Us
programme.desc: After Birch watches a late night mockumentary on TV about aliens among us, she becomes a big ball of paranoia as she misinterprets her schoolmates head twitches, hand gestures and overall comportment. What she doesnt know is theyre planning a surprise party for her and are acting all mysterious around her.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Mascot
programme.desc: Liam is asked to help out the soccer team when an injury sidelines Raffi. Immediately thrilled to be part of the team any team Liams joy turns to humiliation when he realizes the other players want him to be the mascot, not an actual player.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Leads A Parade
programme.desc: As Mother tries to get baby William to sleep, Olivia, Ian and Julian create a backyard parade. When Francine finds out, she decides shes going to make her OWN parade. Olivia eventually sees that two parades can be better than one and even figures out how to keep fussy William asleep.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Tends To The Sick
programme.desc: Julian comes down with a case of itchyfootitis, so its Dr. Olivia to the rescue, with all kinds of silly treatments. When the condition begins to spread to others, Olivia imagines herself running an entire itchy foot clinic, and eventually discovers the perfect cure.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And The Babies
programme.desc: After noticing all the great compliments Mother receives on account of adorable baby William, Olivia finds herself some babies of her own: her cat Edwin and her dog Perry. Being a mum is tougher than it seems, but when Mother asks Olivia to watch William for a minute, her new skills come in handy.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivias Pirate Treasure
programme.desc: When Olivia and her family go to the beach, Olivia finds what she thinks is a pearl-making oyster. She enlists Ian and Julian to help her find more, imagining that theyre pirates in search of buried treasure. In reality, Father explains that theyve actually found clams: no pearls inside, but great for a clambake!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Photo Day Disaster The Eightful Eight
programme.desc: When Rodney heads to the Community Center for Junior Security Cadet picture day, TZG secretly helps him stay neat and clean for the photo shoot. When Luis worries about his first ever math test, TZG secretly helps steady his nerves.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Robo-Dog Day Afternoon Spoiler Alert
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Fleshed Out Messy Business At The Manor

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Paramedic Paranormal Back To Ghoul
programme.desc: Paramedic Paranormal When Jimmy breaks out in hives, Casper and his friends have no choice but to bring him to the human hospital. Back To Ghoul When Caspers uncles Stinky, Fatso and Stretch decide to go back to Scare School, Casper is thrilled.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Glitter Guide Piano Panic
programme.desc: When the Dews find out their glitter guide an older Dew Drop is coming to visit, they bend over backwards to make a great first impression, but end up forgetting some of their responsiblities in the process. When a string breaks on Marcus piano before his recital and he cant practice, the Dews must lead Marcus to a new piano.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Dew Drops Day Off Up All Night
programme.desc: When the Dew Drops have the day off, they discover their families still need their help when theyre not around. Harper needs a good nights sleep before her first day of Cooking Camp. But when an overtired Nicholas keeps her awake, the Dews must help keep Nicholas quiet, even if it takes all night.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Sea Monsters Puff Fruit

夏日奇妙书 My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的.

programme.title: 正义女神 Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.desc: 访谈节目一周星星，每集邀请星级艺人界别名人，与区永权许文轩王镇泉等娱乐主播，分享新近工作企划，谈论电影电视演唱会相关的特别话题，尤其是网民与圈中朋友关心热议的人和事！周边讯息如此多，节目特设Fact Check核实环节，由嘉宾亲自回应各式各样的传闻，让当事人说清楚个中真相！.

programme.title: J Music J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music致力打造高质音乐平台，一众歌手有展示音乐实力的机会之余，也可让乐迷更深入了解歌手的音乐故事节目邀请人气歌手担任嘉宾，由嘉宾亲自挑选其喜欢的新旧作品，并即场演唱，分享喜爱曲目而一些乐坛新面孔亦会亮相，透过互动交流，展现音乐潜力此外，每集紧贴劲歌金榜最新形势，送上歌曲MV外，还会带来不同歌手创作人或制作人的访问，跟观众畅谈作品，以至音乐业界的人和事.

programme.title: 美食新闻周报 Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食！黄嘉雯倪嘉雯伍倩彤等美食主播主持，紧贴最新美食潮流，从不同平台网罗超人气餐厅消息，主持亲自试食，带来真实食评；发掘各区扫街名物，又相约居港多年外籍人士，到访经他们认证的家乡风味食肆；名厨食评家亦会带路搵食，带来专业推介节目精选美食新闻报道介绍的多间人气餐厅，力推当中招牌美食，并会速递美食优惠，让观众实时掌握最滋味抵食的饮食情报.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司銷售經理林信丁子朗飾時裝店老闆夏莉馮盈盈飾同居多時，愛情漸變平淡，兩人對將來也存在分歧情侶間日積月累的矛盾不滿一發不可收拾，林信夏莉爆發激烈爭吵下引致車禍經歷生死一剎後，踏實賢淑的夏莉變得熱情率性，事事以林信為中心，甚至介入其圈子，為林信的姊姊林善車婉婉飾上司麥美娜姚嘉妮飾競敵駱偉滔張頴康飾好兄弟穆家傑馬貫東飾和區文黃庭鋒飾帶來巨大衝擊！林信縱跟夏莉重拾初相識的浪漫與情愫，但眼前的她猶如判若兩人，林信不禁思疑對方還是否真愛？.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 赤沙印記 四葉草.2 Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: 沙灘上，少年十五二十時；他們拋汗， 他們隨入情網葉菁楊婉儀葉蕙李思欣及葉茵陳自琦三姊妹小時侯 碰到一個古上賊女郎部容衢兒，女郎預言大家姐將在十八歲那年，遇見身上有四葉草胎記的真命天子轉眼間三姊妹已長大，現在是清嵐國際學校的中六生清嵐沙灘排球隊的隊長干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活潑，是校內的風頭人物，很多女同學也為了他而加入沙灘排球隊，猶如行星屋繞太陽一般一日，三姊妹分別在不同的角度看見臣身上有一個近似四葉草形狀的胎記，跟小時侯聽到的預言吻合，但菁為人優柔寡斷沒有主見，菁與茵因因此拋身而出，為製造機會給姐姐而不斷奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙灘排球隊她們覺得的是，她們竟又在校內的壘學士方上發現四葉草胎記！三姊妹頓感迷悶，不知道吉卜賽女郎所言的真命天子究竟是誰.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Three Days To Kill
programme.desc: Seorang ejen perisikan antarabangsa yang berbahaya bertekad untuk meninggalkan kehidupannya yang penuh risiko demi membina hubungan yang lebih rapat dengan isteri dan anak perempuannya yang telah lama terpisah. Tetapi terlebih dahulu, dia perlu menyelesaikan satu misi terakhir - walaupun itu bermakna dia perlu menguruskan dua tugas paling sukar setakat ini: memburu pengganas paling kejam di dunia dan menjaga anak perempuannya yang remaja buat pertama kali dalam sepuluh tahun, sementara isterinya tiada di bandar.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Black S1 EP2
programme.desc: Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang Bunian 444 atau juga dikenali sebagai Black sedang diburu kerana rakan setugasnya seorang penderhaka, 419, telah melarikan diri ke dunia manusia. Menyedari 419 telah menghuni tubuh manusia, Black memutuskan untuk memasuki tubuh Malik untuk bersaing dengannya. Pada mata manusia, Malik telah terselamat daripada kematian dengan menakjubkan sekali dan akibat kejadian itu dia telah hilang ingatan. Dalam pada itu, Sofia mula menyedari yang Malik merupakan buat hatinya semasa kecil dan dia diselubungi rasa bersalah kerana telah meletak Malik dalam situasi bahaya. Namun Malik sekarang ialah Black - biadab, mementingkan diri sendiri dan tekad dengan satu tujuan dalam misinya. Adakah dia akan ingat siapa Sofia sebenarnya? Black mendapati dirinya berdepan dengan pembunuhan yang mengerikan semasa dia cuba mengharungi dunia manusia. Keadaan menjadi lebih rumit apabila seorang lelaki yang penuh misteri muncul dan membayangi setiap gerak-gerinya.

programme.title: Black S1 EP3
programme.desc: Black mula seronok berada dalam badan manusianya. Namun menghuni tubuh badan manusia ialah jenayah Kelas A dalam dunia Bunian - Black menerima kata dua - dia mesti dapat mencari 419 atau menerima hukuman yang paling menggerunkan. Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: Bersuara Tapi Tak Didengar
programme.desc: Seorang peguam muda yang hidup dengan sindrom Tourette sering menjadi mangsa penghinaan dan diskriminasi. programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. programme.title: Jiran

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Jin Notti

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Diari Abah
programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.

programme.title: Me VS Mami

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.desc: Shella Amanda Salma yang sering kecewa dalam percintaan dikejutkan dengan kemunculan Rangga Antonio Blanco Jr, seorang lelaki yang mendakwa dirinya ialah suaminya dari masa hadapan. Di tengah-tengah konflik keluarga dan kisah cinta yang semakin rumit, Shella terpaksa mengharungi hari-harinya bersama Rangga sambil mencari kebenaran di sebalik pengakuan yang sukar dipercayai itu.

programme.title: Mega Series Suara Hati Istri: Anjani
programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: JOSEON CHEFS ((需云杂方))
programme.desc: A nobleman who has passed the national civil service exam meets the self-proclaimed best chef in Joseon, falls into the world of gourmet food, and sets out to find the life he truly wants. (一位通过国家公务员考试的贵族遇到了自称为子最好的厨师,)

programme.title: CASSIOPEIA (卡西奥佩亚)
programme.desc: Soo-Jin is a successful lawyer and loving mother who tries to live a fulfilling life after her divorce, but things start to fall apart when she is diagnosed with Alzheimers after a car accident. (Soo-Jin是一位成功的律师, 也是一位热爱母亲, 她离婚后试图过上充实的生活,)

programme.title: MY DAUGHTER IS A ZOMBIE ((我和我的僵尸女儿))
programme.desc: Jung-hwans daughter, Soo-ah, is infected with a zombie virus. He notices that she still seems to understand words, so he draws on his experience with animal training to guide his zombie daughter. (Jung-whans女儿Soo-ah感染了僵尸病毒。他注意到她似乎仍然能理解语言,因此他吸取了动物训练的经验来指导他的僵尸女儿。)

programme.title: TAEYONG: TY TRACK IN CINEMAS ((泰容：TY Track 大电影))
programme.desc: Taeyong is the first NCT member to make a solo debut. He released a mini album and held a 2-day concert. Witness his outstanding performance and take a closer look at him behind the stage. (Taiyong是全国技术中心第一位独奏会成员。 他发行了一张迷你专辑,并举行了为期两天的音乐会。 他见证了自己的杰出表现,并仔细观察了幕后情况。)

programme.title: NORYANG: DEADLY SEA ((露梁海战))
programme.desc: Based on the historical Battle of Noryang in 1598. A story of Yi Sun-Shins last battle during the Japanese invasions of Korea. (根据1598年北阳战役的历史故事. 故事讲述了日军在韩国入侵期间最后一次战斗的义孙欣.)

programme.title: BOTTOM OF THE WATER ((水鬼))
programme.desc: Ga-youngs sister died six year ago. One day, Ga-young is chased by a vengeful water spirit who appears as her sister. She strives to solve the mystery of her sisters tragic death. (六年前,Ga-youngs的姐姐去世了.有一天,Ga-young被一个复仇的水灵追赶,她扮演了她的姐姐.)

programme.title: LOVE RESET ((爱情重置))
programme.desc: A couple decide to divorce after two years of marriage. They revive a 30-day divorce settlement period from the court, but then they both lost memories after a car accident... (两年结婚后,一对夫妇决定离婚,他们恢复了30天的离婚和解期限,)

programme.title: NEW TRIAL ((法律与秩序：陪审团))
programme.desc: A lawyer in debt finds new meaning to his job when hes enlisted by a young man to clear his name after spending 10 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. (一个债务律师在一个年轻人招募他,)

programme.title: HOLY NIGHT: DEMON HUNTERS ((神圣之夜：恶魔猎人))
programme.desc: A city descends into chaos, plagued by a demon and his followers. Holy Night, a special team steps in to bring justice to the forces of evil. Will they be able to save the world? (圣夜,一个特殊团队进来,为邪恶的力量带来正义.他们能拯救世界吗?)

programme.title: HANDSOME GUYS ((星期天帅哥))
programme.desc: Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-Pil and sexy guy Sang-Gu move to a countryside home. A spirit sealed in the basement awakens, leading to a high-stimulus chilling comedy theyll never forget. (简介:自称的强硬男孩杰皮尔和性感男孩桑格格搬到乡村家园.)

programme.title: THE FIRST RIDE (第一旅程)
programme.desc: Four lifelong friends reunite for a long-postponed trip to Thailand. An uninvited guest suddenly joins in and their dream trip begins spiraling into total, glorious chaos. (四个终身朋友重新团聚,前往泰国的行程被长期推迟。 一位未受邀请的客人突然加入其中,他们的梦想之旅开始演变成彻底的、光荣的混乱。)

programme.title: HOPELESS ((无奖竞猜))
programme.desc: Yeon-gyu has never gotten what he wanted in life. With Chi-geons help, he joins the gang and struggles to hold on to hope, but soon finds himself facing even more dangerous situations. (-从来没有得到他想要的东西. 凭借奇帮的帮助,他加入了帮派,并努力坚持希望,)

programme.title: COLD EYES (寒冷的眼睛)
programme.desc: Yoon-joo, a rookie detective, joins a crime unit specialises in surveillance activities of high-profile criminals. They work together and track down a dangerous robber and his crew. (-朱,一个新生侦探,加入一个专门监视高调犯罪分子的犯罪单位.)

programme.title: CONFIDENTIAL ASSIGNMENT 2: INTERNATIONAL ((共助2：国际))
programme.desc: N. Korea detective returns for another secret mission. Despite having different underlying motives, 3 countries join forces to bring down an international crime organization. (尽管有不同的动机,三国团结起来摧毁国际犯罪组织.)

programme.title: 71: INTO THE FIRE ((向着炮火))
programme.desc: 71 student-soldiers fight an impossible war against the elite 766 Commando Brigade and turn the tide of the Korean War. (七十一名学生士兵与精英766指挥旅进行了不可能的战争,)

programme.title: CASSIOPEIA (卡西奥佩亚)
programme.desc: Soo-Jin is a successful lawyer and loving mother who tries to live a fulfilling life after her divorce, but things start to fall apart when she is diagnosed with Alzheimers after a car accident. (Soo-Jin是一位成功的律师, 也是一位热爱母亲, 她离婚后试图过上充实的生活,)

programme.title: THE MOON ((从地球到月球))
programme.desc: An astronaut is left stranded in space because of an accident during a spaceflight. The former director of the space centre strives to bring him home safely. (航天中心前主任努力将宇航员安全带回家。)

programme.title: THE LOST CHOICES (失去的选择)
programme.desc: A young woman who has speech disorder is raped while on her way home. The police do not believe in her. She is frustrated and thus triggers her silent revenge against the world. (一位有言语障碍的年轻妇女在回家的路上被强奸,警察不相信她,她沮丧,因此引发了对世界的无声报复。)

programme.title: THE ASSASSIN ((绝命杀手))
programme.desc: Swordsman Lee Nan hides in a village to escape from his enemies. There, he witnessed people are desperate for help and the killer buried in his heart finally makes his appearance. (剑客李南躲在村子里逃避敌人。在那里,他亲眼目睹人们急切地寻求帮助,而埋藏在他心底的凶手终于露面。)

programme.title: THE FIRST RIDE (第一旅程)
programme.desc: Four lifelong friends reunite for a long-postponed trip to Thailand. An uninvited guest suddenly joins in and their dream trip begins spiraling into total, glorious chaos. (四个终身朋友重新团聚,前往泰国的行程被长期推迟。 一位未受邀请的客人突然加入其中,他们的梦想之旅开始演变成彻底的、光荣的混乱。)

programme.title: TRAIN TO BUSAN ((釜山行))
programme.desc: While a zombie-virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers including a father and young daughter, a couple, and several students struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan. (在韩国爆发尸病毒时,乘客包括父亲和小女儿,一对夫妇和几名学生在于在首尔到布山的火车上扎.)

programme.title: THE KINGS LETTERS ((国之语音))
programme.desc: King Sejong desires to create an original alphabet for his people. With the help of others, they struggle to create the Korean alphabet Hangul. (随着其他人的帮助,他们努力创造韩国字母汉古尔.)

programme.title: Dear X ((亲爱的X))
programme.desc: Dear X follows Baek Ah-jin, a top actress who leverages her beauty and popularity to further her career through manipulation. She harbors a lot of grudges behind her somewhat good-natured demeanor. (亲爱的X跟随了Baek Ah-jin,一位顶级女演员,她利用她的美丽和人气来推进她的职业生涯.)
