programme.title: Her Railway Trip (她的铁路旅行)
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. (日本铁路世界千差万别,从风景山谷到海岸线。 每条火车的车窗都像一幅风景绘画,吸引了铁路爱好者。近年来,它也吸引了许多妇女,产生了一个独一无二的叫Tetsuko的绰号叫Tetsuko的火车女郎。这个由即将上台的女演员Ni Jiawen和He Yongsao牵头的节目,通过日本铁路旅行的魅力,让观众走上旅程。它不仅介绍铁路本身,还探索铁路横跨的地道和城市,展示铁路和城镇交织创造的独特景观。不管你是铁路爱好者还是观光者,都喜欢探索新的文化,Tetsukos Lofty山提供了一条浪漫和令人惊讶的铁路旅程。)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong ((有港回信))
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. (报道关于香港,跨海和国际事务的重要新闻.)

programme.title: Grow Grow Grow With You (与你一起成长成长)
programme.desc: From Hopscotch to Hands Up, TVBs childrens programs have accompanied childrens growth, creating countless wonderful childhood memories. Veteran childrens program hosts Tam Yuk-ying, Lai Chi-shan, and Gai Sai-bo have also grown up alongside you! Each episode will feature a different theme, inviting hosts from different eras to reunite and reminisce about the past. Decades have passed, and the young hosts and participants of yesteryear have all grown up considerably. The hosts have gone out of their way to find these people and relive those memorable moments with everyone. The classic segment Soaring Through the Air holds countless happy memories. The hosts and guest Ali Lee will guide a new generation of children through the fun. (从Hopscotch到“举手”,TVB儿童节目伴随儿童成长,创造了无数美好的童年记忆。老童节目主播Tam Yuk-ying、Lai Chi-shan和盖赛宝也与你们一起成长!每集的主题将不同,邀请不同时代的主持人重新团聚和回忆过去。十年已经过去,过去年的年轻接待者和参与者都长大了很多。东道主已经离开自己的路去寻找这些人,与每个人一起重新体验那些难忘的时刻。经典的空中飞跃段有着无数快乐的回忆。东道主和客人阿里·李将引导新一代儿童度过乐趣。)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. (儿童节目"手上升"鼓励孩子们勇敢地问问题,表达自己,追求自己的目标!子家族成员加入主持人表演短短剧,陪伴所有人享受快乐的时刻.节目还将有各种儿童歌曲,让孩子们一起唱歌,同时学习实用生活知识.)

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue ((过街英雄))
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue ((过街英雄))
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. (据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

It brings in medical professionals and hosts to educate the public on disease prevention, healthy living habits, and wellness management, encouraging viewers to pledge toward a healthier lifestyle (《健康承诺信》是一项以保健为重点的信息方案,在TVB Jade上开展提高公众认识的活动,它吸引医务专业人员和东道主对公众进行疾病预防、健康生活方式和健康管理教育,鼓励观众承诺建立更健康的生活方式。)

programme.title: Mystery Files ((苏联神秘档案))
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins. (爱是一个极其复杂的话题,周围环境因素众多,可以改变我们的梦想和对浪漫的理解。 从年龄变化、互联网文化的兴起、骗局和其他看似不寻常的原因等诸多因素导致社会上出现奇特的、充满世界观的爱情故事。 由Fire Lee、Jinny Ng和Randal Tsang主办的TVB+实况节目神秘文件邀请各行各业的人、名人客人和关系专家讨论每个事件的主题。 他们以独特的视角和发人深省的问题,大胆地探索情感困境,同时也欢迎观众通过现场聊天室和来宾参与对话并共同解决问题。)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. (据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: News At 18:30 ((重轻参与的播客))
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30. (每天下午6点30分,Jade Channel报道了重要的当地,跨海峡和国际新闻.)

programme.title: Sunday Report 2026 Yes, Boss. ((册杀 Yes, Boss.))
programme.desc: Sunday Report focuses each week on popular newsmakers with feature reports, or takes a human-centered approach by visiting people from various social strata and industries to explore in depth political, social, and livelihood issues that concern the public. (星期天报告每周重点报道有专题报道的受欢迎的新闻制作者,或采取以人为中心的做法,访问来自各社会阶层和行业的人,深入探讨公众关注的政治、社会和生计问题。)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4 has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating masked, igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4. (中世纪, Sing Shine! 4 正式启动,继续前三个赛季的成功,并再次为歌唱爱好者提供舞台,以追求梦想。这个赛季将招募工作扩大到北美和澳大利亚,一些TVB艺术家蒙上面具,在全球点燃音乐火焰,点亮无数梦想家的心。 Stephanie Che 继续担任东道主,向参赛者Maria Cordeo、Chow Kwok-fung、张家廷、海尔和Gu Ya-wei提供热烈的笑容,向参赛者们提供法官,向参与者提供专业反馈和鼓励。在这个新赛季阶段,每个人都会用音乐来更感动的一章,继续讲述中世纪的衷心故事,Sing Shine!)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2 ((女神配对计划 Sr.2))
programme.desc: The core premise revolves around TVBs eligible single female artists dubbed the Goddesses who participate in an unscripted journey to find real romance. Single male contestants from all walks of liferecruited through a worldwide open casting callcompete through speed dates, interactive challenges, and romantic one-on-one dates to win their hearts. (核心前提围绕有资格的单身女艺术家TVB(TVBs)进行,她们称女神为女神,她们参加了一次无节制的旅程,寻找真正的浪漫。 来自各行各业的单身男性参赛者通过世界范围的公开竞技比赛,通过速度日期、互动挑战、浪漫的一对一约会赢得他们的心。)

programme.title: Star Weekly ((一周星星))
programme.desc: The talk show Star Weekly invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth! (脱口秀节目《星周刊》邀请名人和产业领袖及娱乐主持人, 如Au Wing- Quen、Hsu Wen-Husu、王朝川等, 分享他们最近的工作计划, 讨论有关电影、电视、音乐会等特别议题, 特别是网民及产业朋友关心及讨论的人士及活动! 节目内容多,)

programme.title: J Music 2026 (音乐2026年)
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry. (J音乐致力于创建高质量的音乐平台,为歌手提供展示其音乐天赋的机会,同时让音乐迷能够更深入地了解其音乐故事。这个节目邀请流行歌手作为嘉宾,亲自选择其最喜欢的新旧作品,现场演出,并分享其最喜欢的曲目。音乐场面的新面孔也将出现,通过互动交流展示其音乐潜力。此外,每集都密切关注《玉实金图》的最新发展,包括音乐视频和与各种歌手、作曲家和制作者的访谈,他们讨论他们的工作以及音乐行业内的人与活动。)

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information. (香港是全球烹饪的熔炉。 食物锚和东道主如黄卡梅尼、 黄卡门、 吴嘉明、 吴吉良等,不断了解最新的烹饪趋势,收集各平台上顶级餐厅的信息,主播亲自抽样食物,提供诚实的检讨,发现不同区藏有的宝石,邀请长期外雇人员访问他们最喜爱的家乡菜园知名厨师和食品批评者,也引导他们走上道路,提供专家建议。 节目特别选取了《食品新闻报告》中热门的餐厅,突出他们的签名盘子,提供快速交易,确保观众了解最美味、最廉价的餐饮信息。)

programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings together.

programme.title: Ready OR Knot ((不日成婚))
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not? (盖伊和海迪在婚宴上第一次见面以来已经在一起五年了,但婚姻很快就成为了他们关系的挑战.海迪认为婚姻是他们爱的见证,而盖伊认为这是末日.)

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate ((龙虎门))
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan. (龙虎王从著名的香港漫画改编而来,在无意中攻占卢沙广场后遭到伏击,但获其兄龙王救赎。 在战斗中,他们也成为Turbo Shek的朋友,三合会形成兄弟关系。 为了为龙门大师的死报仇,他们训练并发誓击败卢沙氏族领袖Shibumi。)

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon ((望月))
programme.desc: Mei Zhens family appears to get along but harbours deep secrets. Mei Zhen is trapped in a dead-end job with a toxic boss, her brother hides his separation and their mother grapples with lingering guilt over her husbands departure years ago. As Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, can the family heal their wounds and find a way back to each other? (MeiZhens一家人似乎相处融洽,但有深奥的秘密。 MeiZhens一家人被一个有毒的老板困在死胡同中,她的兄弟隐藏了分居,他们的母亲因丈夫几年前离家而纠缠不休。 随着中秋节的临近,这个家庭能够愈合伤口,找到一条回路吗?)

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity ((72家租客))
programme.desc: Ha Kung and Shek Kin are sworn brothers, but become sworn enemies in business and every aspect of life after Pinky, the girl they love, marries Ha Kung. It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry. (夏强和石坚是兄弟,但在他们爱的女孩平奇之后,他们成为商业和生活各个方面的死敌。 只有在他们两家商店的房主想在四十年后终止他们的房客时,他们才能解决竞争。)

programme.title: Home Sweet Home ((情归阿拉巴马))
programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boys dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wangs which seem to be related to the accident. (校车事故几乎使船上的所有人都丧生,公共汽车司机在救一个男孩时受伤,部分失忆。谢谢司机,父亲是男孩,王,他带着他和家人住在地下室。然而,司机很快就发现王家的奇怪行为,似乎与事故有关。)

programme.title: Little Red Sweet ((红豆))
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united? (由于母亲遭受了严重的中风,在科隆市的长家族拥有的中国甜点店面临了动荡.他们的女儿牺牲了成为空姐的梦想,以帮助维持家庭业务,但随着她和父亲的冲突,紧张局势日益升高.)

programme.title: Behind the Shadows ((阴守忍者))
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wifes betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken. (欧阳二等兵侦探在调查期间发现了妻子的背叛。他因惊吓而放弃了一个失踪人员案件。不久之后,失踪的人就死了。陈督察怀疑一个连环杀手可能逍遥法外。 欧阳必须用他的能力在另一个人被杀死之前阻止凶手。)

programme.title: Victims ((法律与秩序：特殊受害者))
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victims mother and the murderers mother as they uncover their sons hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth. (一位无情的吉隆坡高中生杀死同学, 揭露受害者母亲与杀人犯母亲在揭发儿子隐藏秘密时,)

programme.title: Wild City ((野性新加坡))
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture. (当酒吧老板的死党兄弟和装满现金的手提箱进入照片中时,追逐就会变得致命。)

programme.title: The Last Dance ((最后的舞动))
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen. (在这场大流行病引发的经济衰退中,负债累累的婚礼策划者沈成在他向丧葬计划者过渡的过程中找到了一条生命线。 他的非常规方法导致出乎意料的成功,他对他的职业生涯和生活的态度在受到尊敬的温大师的启发后发生了转变。)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive? (在愤怒和悲痛的驱使下,他们开始一场无序的暴力斗争,以追击残酷的贩运集团。 他们能摧毁犯罪团伙,让孩子活着回家吗?)

programme.title: Dead Talents Society ((诡才之道))
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must fight to prove herself in the afterlife, where spirits are required to deliver spectacular scares to earn their place. Facing the threat of vanishing if she fails to secure a haunting license, she teams up with a washed-up ghost diva and her spectral agent, who train her to become the next star and stage the worlds greatest fright. (Newbie 幽灵Rookie必须战斗以证明自己在来世,在后世,灵魂必须提供壮观的吓唬以赢得他们的位置。 面对如果她不能获得一个漫无目的的许可证而消失的威胁,她与一个被冲洗的幽灵Diva和她的光谱特工联手,后者训练她成为下一个明星并给世界带来最可怕的情景。)

programme.title: A Murder Erased ((被消失的凶案))
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a death scene investigation where the deceased body had laid undiscovered for eight years. A prosecutor joins the investigation after Choi has identified the suspect, and finds Chois actions suspicious when all manner of inconsistencies come to light from his statement... (崔警官被指派进行死亡现场调查,死者的尸体在调查中8年未被发现。 在崔警官查明嫌疑人后,检察官加入调查,发现Chois在陈述中发现各种不一致之处时可疑。)

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man ((百变星君))
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love. (歌手是一个在国外留学的富人,但被宠坏了,他永远无法专心于学习,而是花时间与女孩调情。 有一天,当他和情妇西尔维娅勾搭在一起时,歌手被黑帮吹了起来。 这个傲慢的恶作剧者被复活了,成了一个拥有独特技能、真正工作和新的真爱的无法打败的半机械人。)

programme.title: The Brotherhood Of Rebel ((扎职2：江湖陌路))
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him. Caught between triad and brotherhood, what will Chai choose? (三合会成员Chai在发现Meow试图杀害其三合会老板后帮助其童年朋友Meow逃离香港。 17年后,Chai成为三合会的关键成员。 有一天,当他跑到Meow时,他知道他的帮派会杀死Meow,如果他们找到他。 在三合会和兄弟会之间,Chai会选择什么?)

programme.title: Midnight Fly (午夜飞行)
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husbands mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price (米歇尔在危机中的婚姻中,在危机中的婚姻中,米歇尔出发前往欧洲度假,会见了一位名叫美木的日本妇女。 当她们成为朋友和一起旅行时,米歇尔发现美木是她的丈夫情妇。 当美木在摩洛哥失踪时,米雪会竭尽所能找到她,但最后却付出了沉重的代价。)

programme.title: Coffin Homes ((鬼同你住))
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead! (在这场针对香港住房危机的恐怖讽刺中, 有三个怪故事相互交织。 香港房地产价格暴涨迫使居民做出一切必要的疯狂努力,)

programme.title: Guilt By Design ((催眠·裁决))
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. The abductors demand that he hypnotize the jury to manipulate the final verdict. Torn between justice and family, he must decide how far he is willing to go to save her. (在香港令人震惊的谋杀案审判的最后一天,一位著名的催眠疗法医生担任陪审员,他收到一段录像,显示他的女儿被绑架。 绑架者要求他催眠陪审团,以操纵最终判决。 在司法和家庭之间,他必须决定他愿意如何拯救她。)

programme.title: YOLO ((乐活姐妹：怪诞冒险))
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey. (黎英在短短的工作经历之后选择退出社会。 一天,在一系列意外事件之后,她决定重新拥抱生活。 当她遇到拳击教练时,她看到了重新开始的机会,但前面的挑战远远超过她的期望,标志着她的旅程充满活力的开始。)

programme.title: Echoes Of The Thunder ((速战))
programme.desc: Two half-brothers, Nam and Fire, are top racing drivers. In a racing challenge with Japanese driver Kenji, Nam causes a young racing driver to be seriously injured and is depressed. Fire stands up for Nam and decides to compete with Kenji in an illegal street car race. Who will win the race? Can Nam finally bounce back? (南和火这两个半兄弟是顶尖的赛车手。 在与日本司机健二的比赛中,南导致一位年轻的赛车手严重受伤,情绪低落。 南和火代表南和南决定与健二在一场非法的街头赛车比赛中竞争。 谁能赢得比赛? 南终于能反弹吗?)

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life ((浅浅岁月))
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime. (桑比娜对安德鲁的深厚爱情在他的恋爱破坏了他们的婚姻后,导致她的心碎.多年后,当安德鲁被诊断患有癌症时,桑比娜选择回来照顾她的前丈夫,尽管过去的痛苦.随着旧情绪的复苏,她仍然相信真正的爱情只会在一生中出现一次.)

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar ((婚前试爱))
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect partners, Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways (琪琪和她的7岁男友西恩将在一周内结婚,但婚前3天两人互欺骗。 面对他们每一个完美的伴侣,琪琪和肖恩忽略了他们彼此的责任,选择了各自的方式。)

programme.title: Good Game ((高手过招))
programme.desc: Several down-and-out individuals find a spark in esports. From a cybercaf to the competitive arena, they form team Happy Hour, battling rivals and lifes setbacks to reclaim a second chance. (从网络咖啡馆到竞技场,他们组成了“欢乐一小时”团队,与竞争对手和生活挫折抗争,以重获第二次机会。)

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman (无敌剑术士)
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown. (为了摆脱武术世界,Linghu Chong陷入了敌对派别之间的激烈冲突。 他投身于神秘的Dongfang Bubai,他的秘密善行拯救了他。 但是,任Wo Xing操纵她相信她屠杀了其他门徒,而Linghu Chong却陷入了一场悲剧性的生死战。)

programme.title: Human Lanterns ((人皮灯笼))
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident (7年后,龙赵龙在决斗中被龙龙击败,龙龙求赵王代表他做个独特的灯笼,以赢得灯笼比赛,而赵王则计划报复。 当长妻突然消失,听到人灯的故事,长妻可能卷入其中。)

programme.title: The Daredevils ((The 夜魔侠s))
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms! (腐败的王利将军通过杀害上司而掌权。 被谋杀的上司的儿子与四位街头表演者建立了朋友关系,他们称毒瘾为“毒瘾 ” ( The Venoms ), 他们帮助他复仇,假扮政府官员向腐败的上将提供和平象征。 当王上将抵达仓库时,他被毒瘾伏击!)

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin ((少林与武当))
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun (在清朝中,少林氏族想推翻清清,恢复明朝,而武当族则得到清政府的支持。 两大知名氏族最终相互对立,一系列恶战刚刚开始。)

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade ((月光小夜曲))
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. (爱情的故事,是关于一个爱情的故事,是关于一个爱情的故事,是关于一个爱情的故事.)

programme.title: Brotherhood ((龙争虎斗))
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable. (刘大江是一个天真的年轻人,在一次金盗出错后被他的宣誓兄弟背叛和猎杀。 他幸免于险,赢得了黑帮领袖的青睐,与保镖金燕一起走上了复仇之路。 随着敌对帮派的冲突和感情的出现,一场暴力的地下大决战不可避免。)

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu ((疯猴))
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult. (陈先生是一位受尊敬的子功夫大师,直到他被一个无情的恶棍入了架子和了,最终成为一个流浪艺术家.当陈在街上遇到一个年轻人,小子,他决定教他他的子功夫运动.)

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist ((霹雳拳))
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly. (一位恶毒的日本柔道专家想证明中国人是亚洲病态人士,并准备在危险的锦标赛中破坏和杀害最优秀的武术艺术家。 为了救他的儿子,平派拳击学会会长派他到山上学习大拳手红蝴蝶的强力雷波特拳法。)

programme.title: Blue Skies ((碧云天))
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show. (云在11点时替换另一位歌手,成为一夜之间一场轰动.她的成功却以高昂的价格来,因为她对钢琴家的爱情受到了痛苦.)

programme.title: The Young Avenger ((小毒龙))
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu? (刘晓华想为兄弟们的死报仇,在战斗中失去一只手臂,十年后发誓复仇。李明华要求姐姐送女儿宝珠去学龙剑之术,为他报仇。 保珠成长成为一名熟练的武士,与刘晓华的表弟陈氏相遇,计划进行决斗。 她能打败刘晓珠吗?)

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth ((大地儿女))
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows... (这是中日战争时期的史诗故事。 一位画家于优拯救了一位年轻女孩Lotus,Lotus,她正被卖给妓院。她们坠入爱河,结婚并安顿下来过上平静的生活。然而,他们的生活很快被日本的入侵和随后的残暴政权所摧毁。)

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox ((新飞狐外传))
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung. (在银狐和传奇传奇的传说 伟大的传说中 福狐来了这个激动人心的冒险)

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City ((解密紫禁城))
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor. (法官发现李新生儿在出生时被换换,女皇20年前驱逐她出宫殿.他让女士承认与女皇的阴谋.女皇因她的行为被定罪,李女士最终与她现在的儿子重聚.)

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty ((血芙蓉))
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back... (飞行国联刺客秘密为皇帝工作,其领导人金正日被派去杀害知道这个秘密的金安。 怀孕的夫人荣阁下试图杀死金,但为了保护她未出生的孩子而撤退。 当她被搜身时,荣与前飞行国联成员及其武术高年级成员勾搭起来反击。)

programme.title: Double Bliss ((双喜临门))
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple. (东中和朱计划结婚,但他们的家族是终身竞争对手,不赞成。 他们决定假自杀,最终让父母双方解决分歧并批准婚姻。 同时,一家唱片公司宣布他们将发行东斯歌曲,为夫妇带来双欢。)

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman ((游侠儿))
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits. (横行的剑客尤希埃(Yu Xieh Erh)掌握强大的剑法,通过抢掠盗贼和分配财富来帮助穷人。 他遇到了一群土匪,他们计划抢劫护送一些贵重物品的车队,并被骗参与抢劫。 尤伊很快就意识到他的愚蠢并返回来报复匪徒。)

programme.title: Dawn Will Come ((魂断奈何天))
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her (梁才给美丽的邱荣下了药,强奸了她,但答应在得到父母同意后娶她。此后,没有关于他求婚的消息,而邱荣在发现自己怀孕时与梁才对质。这时,她发现他已经娶了一个高贵的富裕女孩,甚至计划杀害她。)

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977 (红厅的梦想)
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple. (根据同名的中国经典小说,著名的贾家族的儿子尤深深爱上了他的表弟戴尤.然而,他的母亲不赞成他们的关系,并计划安排尤嫁给另一个富裕的女孩,导致完美的夫妇的悲惨结局.)

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists ((铁观音))
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives! (和Lily Ho一起玩的这个握手的刺激片的首席侦探Lo Wei导演和明星们。 她擅长于一个既能打又能调情的卧底复仇者的角色!)

programme.title: Tragic Commitment ((没有老公的日子))
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby... (当一位医生的丈夫东先生在一次事故中受致命伤时,他向她透露了他与小黑的婚外情,他与小黑怀孕了。 尽管背叛的破坏和丈夫最终死亡,但她婆婆还是施加压力,要她忍受小黑,为她的孩子提供1M。)

programme.title: The Savage Five ((五虎将))
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits. (一群强盗带着被盗的安全柜逃到一个村庄,在那里他们压迫村民,并迫使铁匠威解锁安全柜. 威拒绝并逃离,向官员报告,而城市的英雄们出现在战斗强盗.)

programme.title: The Last Tempest ((瀛台泣血))
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power. (多华王后继此事件之后,广州皇帝和多瓦赫王后仍继续传说光苏和西西皇后的故事。 尽管广州皇帝登上皇宫,但西西始终存在的势力掩盖了他有效统治的能力。 当他改革帝国体制的尝试被多瓦高太后挫败时,广州试图扼制她的权力。)

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress ((萧十一郎))
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao. (故事发生在一个武术世界里,每个人都试图获得鹿剑。 连安的妻子在伏击中受伤,他的对手小晓救了她。她们逃到小施家,他治疗她的毒伤。这导致连怀疑妻子的忠诚,导致与小晓发生几次流血决斗。)

programme.title: The Crimson Palm ((血手印))
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence? (可怜的林文学家与富家女订婚,但她父亲因其家庭背景而看不起他。在出国参加皇室考试之前,林文探亲,只为了发现一个死在血中的女佣。 当现场发现他的血迹时,他成了主要嫌疑犯。 宝法官能证明他无罪吗?)

programme.title: The Golden Knight ((牙狼))
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth (玉飞霞女英雄被控偷窃武术秘密书,为证明她无罪,她假扮成男子汉,进入少林寺了解真相)

programme.title: The Bride from Hell ((鬼新娘))
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell. (方明娶了神秘的年轻女士梁秋平,只为了发现她是一个被迫消耗男人生命精华的精神。 在道教的帮助下,他将她从邪恶的力量中解救出来,但他们的爱无法跨越生死,他们黎明时分就以苦痛的告别告别。)

programme.title: Akhanda
programme.desc: Akhanda, a devotee of Lord Shiva, protects Murali Krishna from Varadarajulus evil scheme. The story unfolds with divine intervention, bringing justice in a captivating tale of righteousness.

programme.desc: After the slaughter of his family by stone-cold mercenary, Hanzo Hasashi is exiled to the Netherrealm, where hes given a chance to avenge his family - and is resurrected as Scorpion, a lost soul bent on revenge. (在被一个冷酷的雇佣兵杀害后,汉佐·哈萨西被流亡到尼特勒姆,在那里他有机会报复他的家人,)

programme.title: Hollywood On Set ((中文))
programme.desc: Each week Hollywood On Set goes behind-the-scenes on three major movies in production, featuring action footage and interviews with filmmakers. (每周,好莱在舞台上播放了三部主要电影,其中包括动作片段和与电影制作人进行的采访.)

programme.title: Epic: Elvis Presley In Concert ((传奇：演唱的猫王))
programme.desc: Elvis sings and tells his story like never before in a new cinematic experience from visionary filmmaker Baz Luhrmann. (猫王在有远见的电影制片人巴兹·卢尔曼的新电影史上 从未像现在这样 歌唱和讲述他的故事)

programme.title: Land Of Gold ((黄金之地))
programme.desc: A truck driver finds a young Mexican American girl inside his shipping container and his life takes a turn as he tries to reunite her with her family. (一名卡车司机在他的货运集装箱里发现了一个年轻的墨西哥裔美国女孩,)

programme.title: Must Love Dogs ((征婚广告))
programme.desc: A lady sets out to change her single status by putting up a personal ad but realises she has too much to handle when men respond to the ad. (一位女士通过发布个人广告来改变她的单身身份,)

programme.title: Jersey Girl ((泽西女孩))
programme.desc: When a successful publicist finds himself an unemployed single father back living with his dad in the suburbs, he learns to acknowledge what truly makes him happy. (一个成功的广告家发现自己是一个失业的单身父亲,)

programme.desc: A mother fights to save the life of her ailing daughter after an unprecedented pandemic ravaged the planet, leaving resources so scarce you must pay for them with your life. (一个母亲为了拯救她生病的女儿的生命而斗争 在一场史无前例的流行病肆虐地球之后 留下如此稀少的资源)

programme.title: Back To The Future III ((回到未来3))
programme.desc: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, its the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy. (回到未来第三部分,马蒂旅行到1885年,从一个逃犯手中救救医生。 充满了欢笑、行动与心脏,这是史无前例的狂野西部决赛,也是最美好的三部曲。)

programme.title: Gods Of Egypt ((神战：权力之眼))
programme.desc: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure. (杰拉德·巴特勒和尼古拉·科斯特-瓦尔达夫演出了竞争对手的神,)

programme.title: Godzilla Minus One ((哥斯拉-1.0))
programme.desc: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror. (在战后的日本,戈迪拉带来了新的破坏. 没有军事干预或政府的帮助,幸存者必须面对绝望,并反击无情的恐怖.)

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop ((幼儿园警探))
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, its a classic comedy-thriller. (阿诺德·施瓦辛格(Arnold Schwarzenegger)星像约翰·金布尔(John Kimble)在幼稚园警察中当强悍的侦探,当教师卧底寻找一位毒枭的妻子。 充满了行动、幽默和心脏,它是一个经典的喜剧表演。)

programme.title: Daylight ((十万火急))
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller! (斯泰洛恩在白天演出,作为一个堕落的英雄, 为了救出被困在纽约道中的乘客.)

programme.title: Shout At The Devil ((大煞星与亡命客))
programme.desc: During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar. (在第一次世界大战期间,一位英国偷猎者,一位美国冒险家和他的漂亮的小女儿开始摧毁一个在桑齐巴尔附近的一条海峡里等待维修的德国战舰.)

programme.title: The Librarian: The Return To King Solomons Mines ((图书馆员：所罗门王的宝藏))
programme.desc: Adventurer Flynn Carsen receives a secret map to King Solomons Mines. When the map is stolen, Flynn sets out to find the map and the Key of Solomons book, without which the map is useless anyway. (冒险家弗林·卡森收到一份索罗门斯国王矿藏的秘密地图。 当地图被偷走时,弗林准备找到索罗门斯书的地图和钥匙,没有地图,地图就毫无用处。)

programme.title: The Revenant ((魂归故里))
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro Gonzlez Irritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness. (莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥和汤姆·哈迪明星在亚历杭德罗·冈萨雷斯·伊里图斯的内脏,关于生存和背叛的史诗故事,是在美洲史无前例的荒野下发生的。)

programme.title: Fist Of Fury ((精武门))
programme.desc: Returning to early 20th-century Shanghai to marry his fiance, Chen Zhen discovers his revered martial arts master has died mysteriously. He launches a relentless quest for vengeance against the rival Japanese dojo responsible. (回到20世纪初的上海与未婚夫结婚时,陈振曾发现他敬仰的武术大师神秘地去世了。 他对日本的敌对斗士发动了无情的报复。)

programme.title: The Big Boss ((The Big 老大))
programme.desc: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling. (一名年轻男孩在表亲失踪后, 违背对抗腐败老板的誓言, 发现生意是毒品走私的幌子。)

programme.title: Kill Cruise (杀死克鲁兹)
programme.desc: When a washed-out German sailor in a drunken state agrees to take two British women from Gibraltar to the West Indies in his sailboat, they realize that its not going to be smooth sailing, and it will take all their wits to survive the trip. programme.title: Hippo Watch with Steve Backshall (Steve Backshall的河马观察)
programme.desc: Having learnt where a hippos aggression comes from Steve wants to find out if we can live alongside the animal that kills up to 500 people a year. He visits St.Lucia, a town where hippos roam the streets freely at night, feeding on the manicured lawns and bushes of the townsfolk. In order to see them out of the water he must come back at night. (学会了史蒂夫对河马的侵犯后,想了解我们是否可以与每年造成500人死亡的动物一起生活。 他访问了圣卢西亚,该镇的河马晚上可以自由游荡街头,在城镇的修剪草坪和灌木丛上吃东西。 为了让他们走出水面,他必须在晚上回来。)

programme.title: Portillos Andalucia ((安達盧西亞深度遊))
programme.desc: In Granada, Michael Portillo meets a food writer and tries his hand at a potters wheel. (在格拉纳达,迈克尔·波蒂洛遇到了一位食品作家,)

programme.title: The Worlds Deadliest Weather ((世界最致命的天气))
programme.desc: A historic flood wipes out Valencia, Oregons third largest wildfire, and the deadliest hurricane to hit U.S. in almost 20 years. (瓦伦西亚发生历史性洪水, 威尼斯人州第三大森林火灾,)

programme.title: Asia (亚洲)

programme.desc: Steve returns home to the Atlantic waters of the British Isles as he considers the question of what humanity can do to ensure the enduring future of whales, which have already survived so much. (史蒂夫回到不列颠群岛大西洋水域时,他考虑了人类能够做些什么来确保鲸鱼的持久未来的问题,鲸鱼已经生存下来很多。)

programme.desc: Robson explores the stunningly beautiful Anavilhanas Archipelago in his canoe. An intricate pattern of tiny islands and lagoons, its a truly magical place, teeming with fish and bird life. (Robson在其独木舟中探索了惊人美丽的Anavilhanas群岛。一个由小岛和环礁湖组成的复杂模式,它是一个真正神奇的地方,充满了鱼类和鸟类的生命。)

programme.title: Big Adventures: Into Thailand with Sue Perkins (伟大的冒险:与苏·珀金斯一起去泰国)
programme.desc: Sue reaches the final episode with a visit to the countrys heady and exotic capital, Bangkok. (苏以访问该国繁忙而异国化的首都曼谷来完成最后一集.)

programme.title: Asia (亚洲)
programme.desc: Many passionate people are dedicated to saving the wild animals of Asia. These individuals and their ingenious solutions give us hope and optimism for the future of the continent. (许多热情人士致力于拯救亚洲野生动物,这些人及其巧妙的解决方案给我们带来了对非洲大陆未来的希望和乐观.)

programme.title: Portillos Andalucia ((安達盧西亞深度遊))

programme.title: Jaguar Journals (捷日志)
programme.desc: Watch the Onafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy. (观察Onfari 团队了解了Aroeira, 也就是他们新被囚禁的女性Aroeira, 并查看了Apolo的Auroras 幼崽。 继续追踪Badalo,他已经深入到洪水泛滥的森林,在那里他将利兹改变游戏的研究置于危险之中。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs. (在动物王国最强大的动物国的强大力量中,巴斯克(Bask)最强大。 以银背大猩猩的岩石硬石白蚁猎犬,用银背大猩猩击打,看到能够粉碎caiman头骨的美洲虎,然后前往海洋见证猎豹群。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey. (随着地球最快的动物运动员的击球, 观看死亡鱼在瞬间袭击, 用鱼进行空中暗杀, 与马龙一起快速吃饭,)

programme.title: Baby Animals ((动物宝宝))
programme.desc: Not all infants in the animal kingdom get to have a good mother. But these are the stories of the lucky ones, from a ring-tailed lemur who learns everything from its mom to a tiny orangutan that receives a constant supply of motherly cuddles. (并不是动物王国的所有婴儿都能有一个好母亲。但这些都是幸运者的故事,从一个从母亲那里学到一切的环尾狐猴,到一个不断得到母亲抱抱的小猩猩。)

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends ((Amazing Animal 老友记))
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer. (这部"惊人的动物朋友"的集中,有一个子,没有她的朋友带她去水里,)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Tasmanian Devil ((Secret 终生惩戒 Of The Tasmanian Devil))
programme.desc: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials mealtime. (对于塔斯马尼亚魔鬼来说,支配性是交配季节游戏的名称。 与那些为传承基因的权利而奋斗的男性见面,并了解这些肉食性肉食的饮食时间的暴力、吵闹的礼仪。)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Tasmanian Devil ((Secret 终生惩戒 Of The Tasmanian Devil))
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the countrys marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. Theyre committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young. (塔斯马尼亚恶魔可能拥有任何国家最臭名昭著的名声,但这些虔诚的碎尸者也有另一面。 他们是忠诚的父母,也是他们年轻时的英雄捍卫者,他们都是靠邮袋长大的年轻人。)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. See how the sun affects the movement, feeding habits, and mating rituals of everything from tiny zooplankton to whale sharks. (从波利尼西亚到印度尼西亚群岛的动物们生活在阳光明媚的热带9月的一天中。 看看太阳如何影响从小浮游动物到鲸鲨等一切事物的移动、饮食习惯和交配仪式。)

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Celebrate the first day of spring with Aussie creatures looking for either a dinner or a date. From the kangaroos in the grasslands to the koalas in the trees to the freshwater crocodiles, they hunt for food or fight for breeding rights. (庆祝春天的第一天,与澳洲生物一起寻找晚餐或约会。 从草原上的袋鼠到树上的考拉,到淡水鳄鱼,它们都在寻找食物或争夺繁殖权。)

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Meet the unique primates and reptiles searching for water and dodging predators, from ring-tailed lemurs in the east coast rainforests to tiny brown leaf chameleons, in this land of extreme climate variations and habitats. (与独特的灵长类动物和爬行动物相遇 寻找水和猎食动物 从东海岸雨林的环尾狐猴 到棕色小叶变色龙)

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Visit one of the most arid and hottest parts of the world to discover how dhub lizards and dromedary camels adapted to withstand the intense conditions. Then move into the more moderate southern mountains, where rare hyrax and chameleons forage. (访问世界上最干旱和最热闹的地区之一,以了解dhub蜥蜴和热带骆驼是如何适应恶劣条件的。 然后进入较温和的南部山区,那里有稀有的hyrax和色素饲料。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends. (非洲是一个充满独特和非凡的动物的大陆,其生命是由数百万年的进化过程塑造的。非洲也是人类的诞生地。我们在自己的进化历程上与各大陆的动物一起旅行,然而智慧使我们走上了一条完全不同的道路。我们的好奇心引出了关于我们周围世界的问题,这些问题通过故事、神话和传说得到了解答。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive. (智利是一只大象,半个树干将小便输给偷猎者,目的是捕捉蚂蚁作为灌木。但是,滥杀滥伤自然意味着其他动物经常与它们发生染污,并产生毁灭性后果。智利现在必须适应没有最重要的大象附着物的生活。她必须学会如何吃饭、喝酒和洗泥浴,以确保她的生存。由于严酷的旱季的附加挑战,智利正在对抗生存的机率。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths most precious ecosystems. (非洲最古老的树木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵树都有自己在旱季生存的战略。 香肠树和无花果树的季节性极端,为在贫瘠时期挣扎的动物提供食物和栖身之处。 作为回报,动物通过授粉花朵和分散种子来帮助这些树木繁殖。 非洲树木促进生命,并成为地球上最宝贵的生态系统之一的支柱。)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera. (在南澳大利亚州执行一个危险的拖拖任务,该任务将展示鲨鱼吃什么,为什么它们聚集在热点地区。 然后,当一个团队向北追赶老虎、公牛和锤头鲨鱼,并装配一个带有360度双角相机的鲨鱼。)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner. (跟踪大堡礁沿岸的一头怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她是否带领一组科学家到她隐藏的抽水场。 然后在南部海岸寻找交配的迹象,这些迹象可能暴露出一个非常害羞的雌性巨型巨型巨型猎物,以寻找伴侣。)

programme.title: Evolution Earth ((地球演化實錄))
programme.desc: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map and prevent global warming. (探索行星迅速融化的极地,动物们正在向科学家们提供有关我们未来生存的线索。 了解北极熊、企鹅和其他北极生物的移动如何帮助人类绘制地图并防止全球变暖。)

programme.title: Evolution Earth ((地球演化實錄))
programme.desc: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)

programme.title: Baby Animals ((动物宝宝))
programme.desc: Watch fur seals give birth by the thousands, black bear cubs wrestle with their buddies, and meerkat pups forge bonds by sharing choresall proving that growing up in the animal kingdom is easier when you have numbers on your side. (看着毛皮海豹生下成千上万的孩子, 黑熊幼崽和他们的朋友搏斗, 和MEERKAT幼崽通过分享杂务来建立纽带, 证明在动物王国长大比较容易 当你身边有数字的时候。)

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends ((Amazing Animal 老友记))
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind. (遇到更多神奇动物之友,包括夏洛特, 一位史考瑟,他享受 洗澡时间与她的小猪伙伴华莱士, 和一只叫哈米什的羊,他喜欢偷偷溜走 与一群奶牛生活 而不是与自己的同类。)

programme.title: Wild Castles (野生城堡)
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians. (探索美丽的艾德尔贝格城堡,其废墟在西德国的内卡河旁边将奇迹强加给西德国的内卡河。 城堡被受保护的自然保护区包围,周围是猎物鸟类的栖息地,是附近两栖动物的产卵地。)

programme.title: Wild Castles (野生城堡)
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of historys greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings. (卡尔卡松曾经是一个财富和文化中心,现在已经成为野生动物的避风港。 鸟类、野猪和昆虫的军队在其富饶的周围生存。 野生动物、野猪和昆虫的军队在野生动物的栖息地中生存。 它们的栖息地是人类的栖息地。)

programme.title: Wild Castles (野生城堡)
programme.desc: Discover the worlds largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region. (发现世界上最大的城堡被雕刻在山洞中。 在斯洛文尼亚,Predjama不仅为中世纪人类居民提供保护,而且还为生活在该地区的鸟类、野猪和山羊提供避难所。)

programme.title: Wild Castles (野生城堡)
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spains Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the regions wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike. (今天,这个世界遗产遗址成为了野生动物的避难所。 阿尔罕布拉有着众多的溪流和喷泉,为两栖动物、鱼类和鸟类服务。)

programme.title: Wild Castles (野生城堡)
programme.desc: Learn how one of the worlds most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries. (了解世界上最壮观的结构之一 — — 纽什旺斯坦城堡及其周围的森林 — — 是如何成为许多生物的家园。从阿尔卑斯山顶到大天鹅,这座城堡数百年来一直是自然的避风港。)

programme.title: Americas Wild Border: Northern Exposure ((美国荒野的季节 Border: Northern Exposure))
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating. (在穿越美国和加拿大之间的国际边界时,Trail Atlantic 浮雕、Prairie 响尾蛇、阿拉斯加驯鹿和其他动物。 看看他们如何通过他们没有发言权的界线从安全转向目标。)

programme.title: Into The Wild Colombia ((进入野外：哥伦比亚))
programme.desc: This is the story of Julieta, a female golden dart frog, in search of her Romeo. Shes about to lay her eggs and must find a male to fertilize them. Romeos calls guide her through the forest, but crossing the dense rainforest is no easy feat. (这是朱丽叶亚的故事,这是一只雌性金色飞镖青蛙,寻找她的罗密欧。她即将产卵,必须找到一个雄性来施肥。罗密欧打电话引导她穿过森林,但穿越茂密的雨林并非易事。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures. (横跨波纹沙丘,在卡拉哈里南部风湿的草原上,一座雄伟的骆驼角,它在这里站了两个世纪。这棵树从来不孤单,知道它如何为许多生物提供食物、住所和狩猎场。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation. (发现深受爱戴的香肠树的故事,它花蜜盛开,香肠制成的水果吸引各种动物,从昆虫到大象。 看看依赖这棵慷慨的树的动物如何确保它的扩散。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches. (在一片迷雾的南非森林里,长了6百年的奥特尼夸黄木。在40米高的地方,她高在树冠上,是她这一类人中仅有的少数。 顺从她那迷人的故事,她的树枝是独特的生态系统。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year. (在南非纳马夸兰的一个岩石山坡上扎根的Namaqua Rock Fig树站着。 它是终极生存者,能够在每年面临气温不断上升和降雨量越来越少的风景中忍受无情的环境条件。)

programme.title: Wild Latin America ((魅力南美洲))
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whales life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey. (跟踪哥伦比亚太平洋沿岸水域新生座头鲸生命的最初几个月。 看看他母亲如何通过疾病培育他,养活他的身体,保护他受到攻击,并准备他经历史诗般的旅程。)

programme.title: Wild Latin America ((魅力南美洲))
programme.desc: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months. (来到哥伦比亚雨林深处,那里是世界上最聪明的猴子物种之一的交配季节。 见证了雄性松鼠猴子一年中最重要的时刻,这些松鼠猴子已经聚集了几个月,以吸引雌性。)

programme.title: Wild Latin America ((魅力南美洲))
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru. (亲眼目睹眼熊的尬和魅力,玩,食,并在秘鲁北部的偏远的夏帕里生态保护区寻找伴侣.)

programme.title: Chasing The Rains (追逐雨)
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter. (前往Samburu, 在那里,当权者Anastasia在当地河流干涸后将大象向北放牧。然后在Naboisho,看到印度豹妈妈Kuleta躲过了一群狡猾的土狼。 后来在Laikipia, 检查了野狗凤凰和她的新的垃圾。)

programme.title: Chasing The Rains (追逐雨)
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuletas loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob. (发现大象挖井的聪明方式,看到突然的河水淹没而来的解脱。 狮子杀死了一只幼崽后,Kuletas的遗书失去了,当野狗菲尼克斯与土狼暴徒对峙时,获得前排座位。)

programme.title: Chasing The Rains (追逐雨)
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land. (特里尔·阿纳斯塔西亚(Trail Anastasia)是她的牧群,她为了保护两个宝贵的大象幼崽而分裂,而库莱塔则夺回她剩下的猎豹幼崽的领地。 随着天空的开阔和雨水开始愈合茂密的土地,凤凰队与野狗联合寻找新伴侣。)

programme.title: Chasing the Rains (追逐雨)
programme.desc: Look behind the scenes and meet the innovative teams working to preserve and protect Kenyas wildlife. Check out Save the Elephants radio-tracking-collar system, a drone that monitors wild dog packs, and a local team of Maasai cheetah trackers. (寻找幕后观察,并会见为保存和保护肯尼亚野生动物而工作的创新团队。 看看拯救大象无线电跟踪领系统、监测野生狗背包的无人机和当地马赛豹跟踪器团队。)

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 河套香港園區第一期兩組地招標收到6份標書，身兼港深創新及科技園主席的創新科技及工業局常任秘書長蔡傑銘接受大鳴大放專訪時，指出投標的公司有做前沿科研及綜合型科企他透露兩園四流：人流資金流數據流生命樣本流，先是數據流及生命樣本流今年年底有些工作完成，人流則待明年流通河套香港園區第一期兩組地有一個實驗室及一個人才公寓，蔡傑銘指共收到5間公司提交6份標書，他指投標公司技術含金量高，當中有3間公司是做前沿科技包括量子晶片及人工智能另兩間投標公司是綜合型企業，有科企和科研部門，所以對園區的實驗室和人才公寓有興趣蔡傑銘指會以技術方案帶來就業機會及經濟效益評核標書，招標採用雙信封制7：3佔比，7成技術3成地價，而早前洪水橋中標價10億3千萬是考參價，不過他強調不同地區的地價有少少分別河套園區對投標公司的定位要求必需是香港創科，符合創科藍圖的六大元素河套港深兩個園區的跨境四流：人流資金流生命様本流及數據流等的流通時間表，蔡傑銘指園區的人氣是很重要，正努力提速完善他指出連接兩個園區的西橋正興建中，檢測樓已平頂二三號樓的兩幢實驗室已建好行人天橋，所以不擔心硬件配套至於無感通關則需時試驗，深圳園區的千人白名單擬定中，正加速進行蔡傑銘表示希望今年年底做到數據流通：現在香港園區已有百多家企業，對數據有一定要求，例如生命樣本的數據低空經濟的一些數據自動駕駛的一些數據，我們已有應用場景，確保這些數據能夠流通到香港園區他強調數據要留在園區，但科研成果可以流出園區，以達到科研商品化成品化至於人流，則隨著連接兩園的橋興建進度，最遲明年年中四個流通有不同程度的實施方案，蔡傑銘說：初步我可以承諾到數據流和生命樣本流，我相信今年年底我怎樣都有些工作會做到，人流可能是明年蔡傑銘表示，河套香港園區與北都大學城的相互關係要做好，一號大樓會預留空間給大學城發展InnoHK 旗下的8間研發中心，有諾貝爾獎得主加入，有香港的大學與海外大學科研交流，包括劍橋倫敦美國及歐洲的知名大學，以及中科院，將科研成果國際化蔡傑銘透露InnoHK的平台會放在河套香港園區，園區的優惠政策會讓科研發展得更好

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 集換式遊戲卡牌的店舖正在迅速增長，卡展總是人山人海，更有被視為死場的舊式商場因為卡舖進駐，而變得熱鬧爆卡打deck成為不少大人小孩的消閒活動集換式遊戲卡牌又名TCG卡，即是Trading Card Game，不少熱門IP都會推出相關產品玩家透過購買內容隨機的卡包與其他玩家交換，可用作遊戲對戰或收藏今年31歲的遊戲卡店老闆Eric，本身也是資深卡友，初中便因為喜歡的日本動漫遊戲王推出卡牌遊戲而入坑當過廚師，亦在玩具店工作過，兩年前決定開店推廣卡牌遊戲有別於電子遊戲，Eric認為玩卡牌遊戲可以與志同道合的朋友面對面溝通，增進感情，而卡牌數目過千，可以構思獨有的牌組，極具挑戰性有好的交流，還有火花有競爭，真的會腎上腺素上升，感覺挺享受的有人用作對戰，亦有人用作投資九十後收藏家Anthony在2012年買賣紀念鈔賺到第一桶金，之後開店買賣及鑑定收藏品，從錢幣郵票到漫畫手稿等都有涉獵他說十多年買舊卡收藏，只是希望回味兒時抽Pokmon卡包，與同學交換卡牌的回憶，但隨著近年討論熱烈，不少稀有卡牌價格翻倍，更比得上置業首期今個世代，無論九十後零零後還是一零後，動畫幾乎入血，對他們而言，動畫情意結是遠超於任何傳統藝術TCG卡熱潮，到底是曇花一現的泡沫，還是會帶來更多可能？

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.title: 대한민국을 바꾼 법의 탄생 : 헌법을 말하다
광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 동시방영작여성향 게임 세계는 모브에게 가혹한 세계입니다2
아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Cocomelon Dan Sahabat
programme.desc: Cocomelon merupakan seri animasi yang menceritakan kehidupan sehari-hari JJ, saudara-saudaranya, dan teman-temannya dalam dunia yang cerah dan penuh warna. Melalui lagu, permainan, dan petualangan sederhana, mereka belajar tentang keluarga, sopan santun, angka, huruf, serta nilai-nilai moral seperti tolong-menolong dan kasih sayang.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Bima S
programme.desc: Bima-S adalah sebuah serial animasi superhero Indonesia yang didasarkan pada serial Bima Satria Garuda. Serial ini mulai tayang pada tanggal 4 Oktober 2020 di RCTI, dan dilanjutkan dengan musim kedua yang juga tayang pada 23 Oktober 2022. Bima-S kemudian pindah tayang dari RCTI ke MNC TV di pertengahan penayangan Season 2. Setelah itu, Bima-S juga mulai ditayangkan di Global TV, salah satu kanal TV milik MNC Group.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Zakstorm
programme.desc: Zak Storm menceritakan petualangan Zak Storm, seorang remaja yang tidak sengaja terhisap ke dalam Segitiga Bermuda saat kompetisi selancar. Di sana, ia menjadi kapten sebuah kapal bajak laut bernama Seven C, dan berteman dengan pedang ajaib bernama Calabrass, yang memungkinkannya berubah menjadi pahlawan pemberani. Bersama krunya yang unik, Zak berlayar mengarungi tujuh lautan di Segitiga Bermuda untuk mencari jalan pulang sambil menghadapi berbagai musuh kuat
